visual.titulo: Can force be justified to protect wildlife?
visual.veredicto: Judge with every stakeholder: conservationists, local communities and poachers

turnos.t: The case study: Akashinga. It was founded in 2009 by Damien Mander as the International Anti-Poaching Foundation and became Akashinga in 2023. It moved from a traditionally adversarial approach to a community-centred, women-led model.

The organisation reports less elephant poaching, paid jobs, children staying in school, and 62 per cent of expenses going to local communities. Notice how I said it: the organisation reports. Unless an independent source confirms it, say that.
